Frontend direct-locator popup flow now opens reliably and width/edge alignment checks passed across required viewports, but same-emoji remove toggle could not be deterministically re-validated in automation follow-up due modal/overlay interaction state.

rca_of_issue: RCA (frontend instability): same-emoji remove verification failure appears tied to modal overlay state and timing between picker selection and immediate bubble re-open, not core backend reaction semantics. Reproduction: open popup via last text bubble -> full picker -> select unicorn (adds badge) -> quickly attempt reopen/reselction for remove; observed either pointer interception by popup subtree or non-hidden assertion mismatch. Mitigation: wait for msg-action-card/backdrop hidden event before next bubble interaction and add deterministic popup-state guard for tests.
